Every size, priced $10 per square foot, $40 minimum. No login, no “request a quote”. Any size you like — these are just the common ones. Prices exclude Washington sales tax and shipping. Pickup in Milton is free. Finishing extras and double-sided printing are priced on top; your quote shows them itemised. Also printing stickers? We print die-cut vinyl stickers from 50 pieces up, with every price published, and large-format decals by the square foot. And we decorate apparel — so it can all be one order and one invoice. See sticker pricing → Questions What's included in the price? Full-colour print on 13 oz Ultraflex Ultima Pro front-lit matte vinyl, sewn hems all the way round, and #2 brass grommets every 24 inches. That's the finished banner — hems and grommets aren't extras. Is there a minimum? $40 per banner. Because of that, every banner up to about 4 square feet (2 × 2 ft) costs the same $40 — going smaller than that doesn't reduce the price. Do I get a discount for ordering several? Not on the banner itself — banners are priced by the square foot, so ten cost ten times one. Where you save is size and setup: one art setup covers the whole order, however many you print. How big can you go? Any length. Our roll prints up to 52 inches wide, so a banner whose shorter side is over 52 inches is seamed from panels — still one banner, and we'll tell you before we print. How long does it take? 10–12 business days from artwork approval. The clock starts when you approve your proof, not when you order. Need it faster? Rush production is available — ask your rep. Can you do pole pockets instead of grommets? Yes — pole pockets are priced by the linear foot and can go top, bottom or both. Tick the box above and your quote shows them itemised. Is sales tax included? No. Washington sales tax is added on your invoice.

A 2 × 3 design prices at our 3 × 3 tier — and we still cut it at your exact 2 × 3 shape. Since you're already on that tier, you can go up to a full 3 × 3 at no extra cost. What's the art setup fee? What are they made of? Printed vinyl with a permanent adhesive, full colour, contour cut to your shape. If you have a particular use in mind — outdoors, vehicles, equipment — tell your rep and they will confirm the right material for it before you order. What about stickers bigger than 6 inches? Over 6 inches we print large-format decals, priced by the square foot, up to 52 inches wide. Same vinyl, same printer. Do you print banners? Yes — 13 oz Ultraflex Ultima Pro FL front-lit matte, sewn hems and #2 brass grommets every 24 inches included, $10 per square foot, $40 minimum. Any size. Is sales tax included? No. Washington sales tax is added on your invoice.
